points.point: Adding a favorite cooking blog as Article context
points.sentence: Sometimes when you try to add a blog, article, or website as new context, you'll see a message related to "enabling Javascript and cookies".

points.point: Why the JavaScript and cookies message appears
points.sentence: This means Blotato's website scraper is unable to access the website due to its anti-scraping policies.

points.point: How to get the blog's content into Blotato
points.sentence: Copy and paste the article, website, or blog, then add it as Text context.

verdict.reason: The entry directly covers the customer's exact symptom of adding a blog as Article context and getting the JavaScript and cookies message, explains the cause, and gives the Text-context workaround.
